sentences.text: 6. Rajiv shall be entitled to the benefit of Section 428 Cr.P.C."

3. Pursuant to the aforesaid order, the Petitioner has undergone seven years of rigorous imprisonment and has also served the default sentence.
4.
The grievance of the Petitioner is that the sentences awarded under Sections 304B and 498A of IPC ought to run concurrently.
By way of the present writ petition, a direction is sought to the jail authorities to treat the sentences as concurrent.

5. In opposition, Mr. Amol Sinha, ASC for the State, submits that in terms of Section 31 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 19732, unless the Court directs otherwise, sentences are to run consecutively.

He, accordingly, submits that any relief to the Petitioner can only be in the nature of a clarification of the judgment dated 25th September, 2014.
6.
In view of the above, subject to orders of the Hon'ble Chief Justice, list the present writ petition before the Division Bench as per the roster on 14th October, 2025.
The record of CRL.A. 69/2014 shall also be tagged along with the present writ petition on the said date.
7. Nominal roll be also requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent before the next date of hearing.
8. Copy of the order be sent to the concerned Jail Superintendent, for necessary information and compliance.
SANJEEV NARULA, J OCTOBER 6, 2025/ab "Cr.P.C."
